lines.en: I find Uta at the archery range first thing in the morning and she wastes no time in subtly reminding me that this is one of the two things she's exceptional at.
lines.zh: 一大早我就在射箭场找到了 Uta，而她一刻也没耽误，马上含蓄地提醒我：这是她擅长的两件事之一。

lines.en: I don't think that's saying much though as the {i}other{/i} thing really just involves conning people into giving her money based on fake affection.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得这话没什么分量，因为{i}另一件{/i}说白了就是用虚假的亲近骗人掏钱。

lines.en: Her affection for me is real, though. It's unwarranted, sure. But it's {i}real.{/i} And even though it {i}shouldn't{/i} be, I accept it. Just as I accept everyone else's.
lines.zh: 可她对我的感情是真的。虽然毫无来由，没错。但它是{i}真的{/i}。而且即便它{i}本不该{/i}是真的，我接受了。就像我接受其他所有人的一样。

lines.en: You see, there's no point in denying anyone's love for me anymore. Because even if I can't return it, I can still benefit from it. And with Uta, there's one thing I've always wanted.
lines.zh: 你瞧，如今再去否认任何人对我爱慕已经没有意义了。因为就算我无法回应，我依然能从中获益。而在 Uta 身上，有一件我一直想要的东西。

lines.en: I should be thankful she gets so easily attached.
lines.zh: 我应该感恩她这么容易动感情。

lines.en: I should be thankful she thinks of me when she's in bed at night and not one of her classmates. I should be thankful I beat all of them out.
lines.zh: 我应该感恩她夜里躺在床上时想的是我，而不是她那些同班同学。我应该感恩我把他们全都比了下去。

lines.en: And I should be thankful that she can remove her eyes from the target long enough to wink at me before letting her arrow fly.
lines.zh: 我应该感恩她能把目光从靶子上移开足够久，好朝我眨个眼再放箭。

lines.en: Why do I want to {i}hold{/i} her?
